verdicts.reason: A reflows into a left-to-right banner with readable headline, body and teal copy, but the dashed dividers have broken into odd stacked fragments, the body wraps with an orphaned 'creativity.', and the booking/website contact text at the right is so small it can't be read. B jams everything into a cramped, misaligned cluster in the middle with large dead areas on both sides: the lines are staggered with no shared edge, the body and contact text are tiny, and a long dashed divider runs into the green copy at the bottom left, so the original's centred stacked structure is lost.
